title: XLT-AxEnvoysAddon
description: An addon for XLTournaments to add AxEnvoys objective.
body:
This addon adds a new objective for the plugin XLTournaments & AxEnvoys to allow a tournament where users must collect envoy crates to score.


# Requires:
[XLTournaments](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/xltournaments-%E2%9C%85-ultimate-global-tournament-plugin-%E2%AD%90-25-objective-types-1-20.70630/)

[AxEnvoys](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/axenvoys-supply-crates-from-the-sky.111411/)


# Configuration:
To use this objective, create a new tournament and set the objective type to `AXENVOYS_OPEN`
